question: How should the imperishable Viṣṇu be worshipped using gāyatrī syllables?
premises: The worshipper places gāyatrī syllables on limbs
inference: One should worship the imperishable Viṣṇu after placing gāyatrī syllables on the limbs.
plain_english: Having placed the syllables of the gāyatrī on the limbs, one should worship the imperishable Viṣṇu.
